reviews.title: Not worth $15 a month
reviews.text: I’ve had The Pattern since it came out. I adored it. I thought it was original and on point. I recommended it to everyone. I’ve been doing astrology for 30 years, so when I recommend something astrology related, it’s really good. Once upon a time, The Pattern gave eerily accurate predictions and daily messages that were on the nose. Now I receive the same few generic messages that are out of touch and meaningless. I recently became aware that I’m getting the same daily messages as everyone else! I have a uniquely singular natal chart so tell me how that’s possible. I used to pay for the app when it was cheaper and way better but quit because it really wasn’t worth it. I came here to write a review once I found out they’re charging $15 A MONTH! For what!? Uninspiring audio? I have YouTube (actually worth $15 a month). Maybe it’s for the questions I can ask? Oh wait, I have AI slop for free with Google. Natal charts can be casted for free in seconds on a myriad of sites and apps that are far better (I recommend Astrology Master, Astro Matrix, & Astro-Seek). So what are they charging for and why is it so expensive? I pay less for tv and music streaming apps. Save your money and buy a good astrology book and DIY your horoscopes (I recommend, The Only Astrology Book You’ll Ever Need by Joanna Martine Woolfolk for beginners). It’s far more rewarding and accurate than The Pattern’s regurgitated AI slop that’s about as accurate as your local newspaper’s horoscopes. I write better hor

reviews.title: Nope, Turn Away
reviews.text:
Don’t use this app! It’s so negative and gross in its projections. Honestly, I used to love this app. I found it helpful to make sense for what I was going through, or it gave me ideas of what I might ponder on. 

But the other day, I realized how much harm it does to look at messages like these.

The future projections… I paid the $30 to look at them and it just about broke my brain, showcasing year after year of pain and struggle, after already moving through such painful years. As someone trying to heal, I realized I was giving my power away to these words and ideas, that are so generic! They have the same themes with the same writing pop up again and again, leaving me thinking, “wow, am I going to be suffering through this my whole life?” It tells me over and over I’m going to struggle romantically, as if trying to forecast I will leave my husband. Karmic relationships and experiences come in all shapes and sizes! Stop trying to project onto my relationship, sheesh.

Our beliefs create our reality, and I don’t think the beliefs we might adopt from looking at this app are healthy for people who want to live a happy life. I’m going to have to spend a whole lot of time purging what I’ve seen from this app out of my brain so I can work on being a better conscious creator of my life.

Our minds pick up and read into more than we’re always consciously aware of. Don’t give your brain away to this app filling you with doubt and confusion. The app itself could really work on being

reviews.title: Recent Updates are Ruining the Experience
reviews.text:
So I already had an issue with the developers just outright charging folks an arm n leg for content that was once free, but now, you can't even chat about the new major transits and shifts since they've just erased that feature - what - last week/2 weeks ago?! Now you have to go to one of the more benign updates and ask the chatbox specific questions about the current transits since they've erased the feature from the info that actually matters. 

Not to mention no longer being able to see most of the media you bookmark in your profile / bookmarked tab?! Like what gives?!

Also - can y'all add vertex point alignments for FRIENDSHIPS?! 👀 Why the heck is it only available in romantic pairings?? Like I get the whole western - especially american obsession with "romantic love" but let's astrology somewhat more seriously please? Vertex points don't just get activated in romantic leaning relationships - and it's quite frustrating to have to run bonds with platonic friends as romances just to see our vertex alignments. I would also like to see more updates on the significance of the Antivertex, as someone who finds value in non-romantic based info. Thanks.

reviews.title: Fall Off Should Be Studied
reviews.text: This app was incredible 5 years ago, but they’ve done nothing but tamper with it since launching. I’ve had this app since it was free—and it carried this air of mystery that felt both spooky-accurate and compelling. Paywalling the content was inevitable. When they introduced the social element I was pleasantly surprised—it helped those experiencing different transits to share how it affected them and suss out the planetary transit at the root of the issue. It was a beautiful addition that made users feel less alone. Then they listened to feedback and incorporated the listed the transit, which removed that air of mystery. All fine changes. Then, about 2 years ago, they started to ruin it—removed the social element all together and began to update the interface to make it almost impossible to find anything. I stuck with it because the content was good—but now they’ve removed that too! The swipe-able insights have been replaced by AI audio that mostly declares just declares that it’s audio and heralds what you’ll find out if you decide to ‘go deeper’ (aka pay money.) This new redesign is egregious, and I have half a mind to uninstall entirely, but another part of me still holds some hope. I figure they’ll probably change it again… possibly for the better? I’ll give it another year.
